approachPoints: Comfortable owning a feature end to end — from the first database table to the last pixel check.
Interfaces stay fast as they grow: state kept local where it belongs, and data fetched close to where it renders.
Reusable components and hooks before repeating myself a second time.
Honest about scope — I'd rather flag a deadline early than go quiet and miss it.
Curious by default: every project ends with me knowing one tool or pattern better than when it started.
